purpose: Independent, unrelated-domain calibration for a pairwise semantic judge contract (relation: equivalent | partial | contradicts | none). Deliberately NOT derived from the 06-salon-booking benchmark, its transcript wording, its gold labels, or its candidate snapshot, so the judge prompt is never tuned directly against benchmark answers.
policyNotes: partial does NOT mean the two statements are merely about the same topic or business area.
partial means both statements express materially overlapping parts of the SAME underlying proposition, but one is narrower, broader, or missing/altering a load-bearing qualifier.
If two statements share a topic/domain but assert different capabilities or rules, the correct relation is none, not partial.
equivalent requires actor + action + object + modality + constraint + outcome to be materially the same; a single missing or changed load-bearing qualifier rules out equivalent.

pairs.propositionB: An order cannot be placed until the customer's email has been verified.

pairs.propositionB: Any wire transfer exceeding $10,000 must be approved by a manager.

pairs.propositionA: Customers can save items to a wishlist.
pairs.propositionB: Customers can leave product reviews after purchase.

pairs.propositionA: Managers can approve time-off requests.
pairs.propositionB: Managers can conduct annual performance reviews.

pairs.propositionA: Only authenticated users may access the online banking portal.
pairs.propositionB: Only branch managers may approve loan write-offs.

pairs.propositionA: Packages over 50lbs require two-person lifting.
pairs.propositionB: Packages must be scanned at every checkpoint.

pairs.propositionA: Tasks can be reassigned by the project lead.
pairs.propositionB: Tasks must include an estimated completion date.

pairs.propositionA: Customer records are accessible only to authorized roles.

pairs.propositionA: Inventory counts are reconciled automatically overnight.

pairs.propositionA: Scope changes must be approved before implementation.
pairs.propositionB: Scope changes may be implemented without approval.
